newsitem.title: USA: Law firm adds defendants to Centennial suit.
newsitem.headline: Law firm adds defendants to Centennial suit.

text.p: Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP said Wednesday it filed an amended class action complaint on behalf of 39 plaintiffs who are investors in Centennial Technologies Inc.

The law firm said it added defendants not previously named in other lawsuits, including Centennial's principal outside auditors and accountants, Coopers & Lybrand LLP, as well as stock promoters Cabot Heritage Corp, publisher of the Cabot Market Letter and Needham & Co, each of whom is alleged to have recklessly or knowingly involved themselves in the Centennial financial scandal.

In addition, the lawsuit includes a separate claim on behalf of persons who purchased Centennial stock on February 25 and who were damaged thereby. On that date, the price of Centennial stock rose sharply, allegedly in response to materially false and misleading statements disseminated by Centennial and its new CEO Lawrence Ramaekers that same day.
